headline: European banks provide 361 billion dollars in financing to firms linked to Israeli occupation
label: NEWS
caption:
A new report reveals massive financial flows from Europe to companies tied to the region. 🌍

According to a report by TRT World, European banks have provided 361 billion dollars in financing to firms linked to the Israeli occupation.

This funding involves various institutions and corporate entities operating across the sector.
